old.lighter: halfway in linear from the wall to the ivory
old.tint: textured base: linear(hex) / linear(sRGB mean of the base map, every 7th texel), clamped at 1

gold.source: DecoKitColourways.Signature[SpaceHQ] on DK_Gold, metallic 1 smoothness 0.45 (Paint/DK_Gold_F2C14E_m100s45.mat), base colour and finish

posters.rule: Per instance, swap the piece's base slot (DK_Billboard_Ads or DK_Billboard_Ads_Lit) for the chosen key's material. Billboards (`adPieces`, `litPieces`) take an ad key; `sheetPieces` take sheet A (keep the base) or sheet B. Same shader, keywords and colour as the base: only the texture and its offset differ.

carPaints.rule: A traffic sedan swaps its piece's `body` slot material for keys[k].body and its `roof` slot material for keys[k].roof; everything else stays. Same shader, keywords and detail pair as DK_CarEnamel_Ivory: only the base colour differs. Presentation only (Pulse mixes, Latch swaps).
